n: <int> Number of entities (and positions) to be assigned in the one-to-one matching.
A: <list[list[int]], shape [n][n]> First cost matrix where entry (i,j) represents the cost contribution from matrix A when entity i is assigned to position j.
B: <list[list[int]], shape [n][n]> Second cost matrix where entry (i,j) represents the cost contribution from matrix B when entity i is assigned to position j.
C: <list[list[int]], shape [n][n]> Linear cost matrix where entry (i,j) represents the linear cost incurred when entity i is assigned to position j.
